buildings.name: Man A Center
buildings.notes:
Oldest structure in Man A. Built August 2nd, 2013.

Oldest Record:
On August 2 at 9:52 PM, while New A is running, you give yourself a command block. 51 seconds later it outputs:

Fire in man a center help

It fires three times.

That is currently the earliest surviving explicit textual reference to “Man A” anywhere in the entire log.

So this is huge: Man A unquestionably existed as a named place by August 2, 2013. And apparently it already had something you called “man a center.”

buildings.name: Canal Street Mall and Office Complex
buildings.significance: historic core, mixed-use, office, mall, civic, redstone, elevated railway, McDonald’s, bombing, bedrock reinforcement, adaptive reuse, villager hub, Canal Street, Cocoa Street redevelopment
buildings.historyNotes: This unnamed Lower Man A complex originated in 2013 as a server room and redstone-testing facility. Between August 2014 and spring 2015, the property expanded into a 22×22 mixed-use complex containing an eight-floor office building, a Canal Street-facing mall, civic and commercial tenants, airline counters, public spaces and a large McDonald’s cheeseburger billboard. The complex also contained a public platform for the Lower Man A Elevated Redstone Express, which passed through Independence Tower and continued to the PATH Station in what is now Midtown Man A. Elevated construction was used because underground construction through sand was prohibitively difficult before WorldEdit. The complex was probably bombed in January or February 2016, with the building itself as the intended target. Developers repaired the damage using bedrock, redesigned portions of the structure and added a 25-block hollow tower above the existing 26-block building, producing a final height of 51 blocks without increasing the eight occupied floors. The same attackers later destroyed the buildings on the future Silvernine Towers site. The complex remained a major center of villager activity until its deliberate demolition in 2018. Cocoa Street and the expanded street grid divided the former parcel into five successor properties: ZAYS Bank, 815 Canal Street, McDonald’s, the Verizon Building and Cocoa Street Parking.

archive.title: Old One World Trade Center Construction
archive.description:
A rare photo showing the One World Trade Center being constructed. At this point, the spire was not added yet, but this tower was absolutely monumental for the city. You can barely see one floor inside the building, but the entire facade has been built out and the core is clearly visible. The tower was built with snow blocks and ice blocks. The facade and core was finished in March 2015 while the spire was then finished April 17th, 2015.  It topped out at 62 blocks tall without the spire and 103 blocks tall with the spire.

It's estimated construction of this building took place between Mid March of 2015 to Late April of 2015.
